purpose: Provenance for extracted presentation, styles and UI interactions. Product controllers and protocols are deliberately excluded.

styles/file-preview.css.changes: Retains original layout; editable ProseMirror content uses pre-wrap to preserve typed whitespace.

presentation/rail-layout-model.ts.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/pointer-drag.ts.changes: Extract the original pointer lifetime helper; omit app storage and composer policy.

presentation/use-app-rail-layout.ts.changes: Keep original snapping, hover and keyboard/drag behavior. Replace product storage/migration with initial value, controlled width and change callback.

presentation/resize-handle.tsx.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/compact-navigation-dialog.t.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/app-navigation-panel.tsx.changes: Original panel, overlay timers, drag handles and compact dialog. Instance IDs replace application-global IDs.

presentation/use-compact-layout.ts.changes: Original media-query subscription only; omit document-wide viewport mutations.

presentation/app-titlebar.tsx.changes: Original titlebar JSX. Brand/artwork and extra actions supplied by caller; remove product updater/account/developer controllers.

auth.tsx.changes: Retain CloudAuthScreen page/form markup and original field, language and submit controls. Replace email-code/country/invite workflow with caller-provided fields, state and actions; configurable brand.

settings.tsx.changes: Retain original settings screen, navigation, back action, headings and section container. Product provides sections and panels; omit Bridge settings load/save and product mode policy.

presentation/room-composer.tsx.changes: Original composer, mentions menu, reply preview, attachments and keyboard delegation. Replace Bridge attachment/member types and URL helpers with render-ready values. Add explicit disabled/capability props.

presentation/room-chat-surface.tsx.changes: Original room chat surface markup and composer. Protocol event processing and resource fetching moved out; caller supplies message content and optional preview overlay.

presentation/room-message-stream.tsx.changes: Original stream, message article, animated author, bubble/reply markup, contextual toolbar and its position measurement. Replace legacy/native protocol interpretation, remote authorization and diagnostics HTTP with render-ready messages and optional callbacks.

presentation/unread-count.tsx.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/unread-count.module.css.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/app-rail.tsx.changes: Original rail, group/button markup, unread badges and account surface. Product supplies navigation groups and account actions. Wallet, withdrawal, cloud profile and fixture-account controllers excluded.

profile.tsx.changes: Original EmployeeSettingsSurface JSX, profile identity editing including Escape cancellation, tooltips, action layout, overview and subpage navigation. Replace RoomMember/Bridge/autosave business with caller-owned identity, metrics, fields, pages and save callbacks.

layouts/compact-list-detail.tsx.changes: Original compact layout, focus restoration and back button. Remove global URL detail controller; product supplies selection and back callback.

layouts/compact-list-detail.module.css.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

layout.tsx.changes: Original conversation row/header, contact search/row and shared compact focus policy. Product supplies list data and actions. Related sources: contacts-view.tsx, rooms-view-layout.tsx, shared/compact-list-detail.tsx.

presentation/app-icon-catalog.ts.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/artwork-identity.ts.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/app-icon-upload.ts.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/grove-app-icon.tsx.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/grove-app-icon.module.css.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/identity-image-trigger.tsx.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/identity-image-trigger.modu.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/app-icon-picker.tsx.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/app-create-wizard.tsx.changes: Original application creation form, icon picker, local draft and validation. All create/open/folder operations already use callbacks; no service client included.

presentation/app-identity-editor.tsx.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

forms.tsx.changes: Extract original employee dialog chrome and app create/identity/settings form JSX. Related source files: apps/app-create-wizard.tsx, app-identity-editor.tsx, app-settings-dialog.tsx. Product supplies form fields/actions; original complete app icon picker/create editor are also exported.

catalog.tsx.changes: Original catalogue title/search, card structure, loading skeleton and detail modal. Replace registry/package API and install/update policy with caller-owned records, action nodes and detail content.

extensions.tsx.changes: Original extension workspace navigation, toolbar/filter controls, result count, skill table, management rows and loading state. Replace SDK actions and deployment protocol interpretation with caller-owned display rows, target nodes and callbacks.

ui/animated-background.tsx.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

ui/animated-background.module.css.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

files/panel.tsx.changes: Original file surface, toolbar, animated mode tabs, loading skeleton and save status. Remove file/Bridge loading, download and persistence; content, errors and operations supplied by caller.

presentation/settings-appearance-panel.t.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/settings-mode-panel.tsx.changes: Original mode control. Remove the explicitly excluded direct-kernel-chat setting.

presentation/settings-apps-panel.tsx.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/settings-kernel-panel.tsx.changes: Original kernel list, expansion and path controls. Product supplies display status, icon and available install action; omit executable commands and capability reports.

presentation/settings-kernel-panel.modul.changes: Original presentation implementation; local imports only.

presentation/settings-connectivity-panel.changes: Original network forms. Rename product Router binding to a caller-owned service address; preserve proxy fields and callbacks without service requests.

presentation/settings-voice-panel.tsx.changes: Original voice configuration fields and validation interactions. Provider options and values supplied by caller; omit backend defaults and Bridge settings schema.

presentation/settings-view-model.ts.changes: Only fields read by the extracted settings controls. No complete backend settings schema, defaults, compatibility or command payloads.

presentation/use-room-composer-keyboard..changes: Original IME composition guard and Enter/Tab/arrow mention behavior. Only sendDraft is supplied by caller; no message delivery logic.

presentation/settings-update-panel.tsx.changes: Original update-page JSX; updater IPC, release protocol parsing, polling, package version probes and install confirmation controllers replaced with presentation values and callbacks.

presentation/settings-desktop-panel.tsx.changes: Original browser desktop/runtime overview and action/info rows. Runtime diagnostics, destructive storage cleanup, desktop IPC and polling are product controllers; receive values, actions and storage section from caller.

presentation/room-header-actions.tsx.changes: Original search, rename and overflow menu JSX and interaction state. Message protocol normalization/member lookup/date formatting removed; caller supplies searchable display records and a scoped locate-message callback.

versions.tsx.changes: Original page header, version row, overview row and switch-confirmation dialog presentation. Status decisions, hashing, version protocols, date formatting, queries and mutation handling stay with the product; section collections and display rows are supplied.

presentation/labels.ts.changes: Only keys referenced by extracted UI; service names and product-specific explanations replaced with neutral copy.

ui/inline-select.module.css.changes: Unchanged source stylesheet or presentation helper.

files/directory-tree.module.css.changes: Unchanged source stylesheet or presentation helper.

files/directory-panel.module.css.changes: Unchanged source stylesheet or presentation helper.

presentation/settings-providers-panel.ts.changes: Preserve presentation markup and styles; replace product records and policy decisions with explicit view data and callbacks. Old standalone operations page/sidebar and provider routing/login controllers excluded.

presentation/settings-operations-panel.t.changes: Preserve presentation markup and styles; replace product records and policy decisions with explicit view data and callbacks. Old standalone operations page/sidebar and provider routing/login controllers excluded.

styles/operations.css.changes: Preserve presentation markup and styles; replace product records and policy decisions with explicit view data and callbacks. Old standalone operations page/sidebar and provider routing/login controllers excluded.

presentation/app-create-dialog.tsx.changes: Preserves original dialog/title/mobile presentation around AppCreateWizard; open state, actions and optional product notice are caller-owned.

assemblies.shell.tsx: Composes original AppTitlebar, AppNavigationPanel, AppRail and rail/compact layout state. No additional navigation DOM wrapper.
assemblies.conversation.tsx: Composes original RoomChatSurface, RoomComposer and RoomMessageStream; caller owns messages/drafts/delivery.
assemblies.layout.tsx: Parameterized row/header/list-detail markup from room-sidebar.tsx, contacts-view.tsx and rooms-view-layout.tsx; compact hook retains original focus behavior.
assemblies.provider.tsx: Instance-scoped English/Chinese presentation labels; persistence and document language belong to the consumer.
